title: Chroma Resampling
text: Downsample or upsample chrominance components of images, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Resampling} sets Chrominance resampling method 4:4:4 to; {Antialiasing filter} sets the chroma downsampling antialiasing filter, {Horizontal filter coefficients} sets the coefficients for horizontal lowpass filter, {Vertical filter coefficients} sets the coefficients for vertical lowpass filter, {Interpolation} sets the chrominance upsampling interpolation method and {Input image is transposed (data order is row major)} sets the read data row-wise. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Cb
ports.summary: Blue-difference chrominance component of image matrix

params.values: Chrominance resampling method 4:4:4 to 4:2:2 (default) | 4:4:4 to 4:2:0 (MPEG1) | 4:4:4 to 4:2:0 (MPEG2) |...

params.name: Antialiasing filter
params.values: Chroma downsampling antialiasing filter Default (default) | User-defined | None

params.name: Horizontal filter coefficients
params.values: Coefficients for horizontal lowpass filter [0.2 0.6 0.2] (default) | row vector

params.name: Vertical filter coefficients
params.values: Coefficients for vertical lowpass filter [0.5 0.5] (default) | row vector

params.name: Interpolation
params.values: Chrominance upsampling interpolation method linear (default) | pixel replication
